notes.START_MISSION: Accepted by Pi and published to mission event bus; mission execution backend is developed independently of the Windows GCS build.
notes.ABORT_MISSION: Accepted by Pi and published as GLOBAL_ABORT; physical abort/landing policy remains Pi-side authority.
notes.SERVO_CONTROL: Transport endpoint is stable. Pi currently ACKs accepted requests with executed=false/backend=PENDING until the mechanism driver is integrated.
